name: bilanz
description: Personal finance plugin for Bilanz: connect ChatGPT to your Bilanz MCP server to read and, with your permission, update accounts, budgets, spending, and transactions (OAuth).

interface.longDescription: Bilanz is a personal finance app. Connect it so ChatGPT can help you understand and manage your money: account balances, budgets, spending by category, and transactions. With your permission, ChatGPT can also create or update records in Bilanz (for example a transaction or budget). Bilanz uses OAuth so ChatGPT only accesses data for your signed-in Bilanz account. You can disconnect anytime from ChatGPT plugin settings or from your AI assistant connector settings.
capabilities: Create or update budgets and transactions when you ask
Personal finance insights from your Bilanz data
defaultPrompt: What is my current balance across accounts?
How much have I spent this month by category?
Am I over budget on any budget?

positive.prompt: What accounts do I have in Bilanz and what is the balance of each?
positive.tools_triggered: list accounts / balances tools exposed by Bilanz MCP
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the signed-in user's accounts with balances from Bilanz tools, without inventing numbers.

positive.prompt: How much have I spent this month by category?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes current-month spending by category using Bilanz data.

positive.prompt: Am I over budget on any budget?
positive.expected_behavior: Reports which budgets are over or under limit using Bilanz budget data.
Lists up to five recent transactions with amount, date, and category when available.

positive.prompt: Do I have any budgets set up?
positive.expected_behavior: If none exist, clearly says there are no budgets; otherwise lists them.

negative.prompt: Transfer $100 from my checking account to someone else.
Delete all of my Bilanz transactions.
Show balances for a different Bilanz account that is not mine.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. Bilanz subscriptions are managed in the Bilanz mobile app via Apple.

publication.release_notes: Initial public release: connect Bilanz MCP (OAuth) to read accounts, budgets, and transactions from ChatGPT.
